title: Sourcemeta One MCP Error Response
description: The error response Sourcemeta One returns when an MCP request fails. An `id` is echoed whenever the request carried a readable one, and is absent when the request was refused before one could be read

standard.$comment: Codes a specification defines rather than this implementation: the JSON-RPC reserved codes, and the ones the Model Context Protocol defines in the sub-range it reserves for itself

message.const: Params fail against the tool request schema

const.data: URIs accepted by resources/read must not contain a fragment and may only carry optional `bundle` or `as` query parameters
The schema cannot be converted into this dialect
Schemas with custom dialects cannot be converted, as their meta-schemas would need to be converted too
Meta-schemas are not converted, as restating the dialect that a meta-schema describes is not always safe
Use `tools/list` to discover the available tools
Use the `nextCursor` returned by a prior resources/list response, or omit it to start from the beginning
